Distinct empty sibling boundaries survive, while first-child before and last-child after values alone do not create empty columns.

Column-scoped keeps retain fitting content and paragraph boundary fragments; oversized keeps start fresh before relaxing for bounded progress.
Page and column avoidance remain scoped, inapplicable column values do not mask ordinary table-row page directives, and unsupported contexts retain typed losses.
Paragraph margin discard retains a pending natural advance which coalesces with an authored force; note and figure reservation paths retain their physical projection.
Completed paragraph line groups keep their completed status across outer-page projection, avoiding a false widow deferral while retaining final unpainted margin ownership.

remainingBoundary: The three named pure/mixed page-force controls retain diagnosed fallback. A browser match does not establish normative page/column forced-break combinations.

Specialized formatting, spanning partitions, nested column owners, floating content, changing page geometry and height-dependent alignment remain outside this ordinary authored column-break qualification.

The selected native controls do not newly qualify tall column notes or edge figures. Their reservation and source/navigation regressions retain focused/full managed validation and their existing separate contracts.

There is no new independent native raster oracle for ScreenFullPage or ScreenSnapshotPaged; continuous DOM geometry, paged PDF glyph geometry, managed output bindings and PDF/PNG equivalence are separate evidence.
